@deskErrSomethingWrong.description: An error message the user reads when nothing more is known (toast, inline error).

@deskErrWrongPassword.description: An error message the user reads when a password is wrong.

@deskErrPhraseInvalid.description: An error message the user reads when the recovery phrase is not a valid phrase.

@deskErrWalletExists.description: An error message the user reads when creating a wallet that already exists.

@deskErrWalletNotFound.description: An error message the user reads when no wallet is found.

@deskErrNodeNotAnswering.description: An error message the user reads when the node does not answer.

@deskErrNotEnoughFunds.description: An error message the user reads when the spendable balance is too small.

deskErrNotTxFile: Not a transaction file for this wallet

@deskErrNotTxFile.description: An error message the user reads when a transaction file does not belong to this wallet.

@deskErrEpicboxUnreachable.description: An error message the user reads when the Epicbox server cannot be reached.

@deskErrNotHttpAddress.description: An error message the user reads when an address is not an http or https address.

@deskErrPlainHttp.description: An error message the user reads when a send to a plain http address was not confirmed by the user.

@deskErrNotOnion.description: An error message the user reads when an address is not a Tor onion address.

@deskErrTorNotConnected.description: An error message the user reads when a Tor send is asked while Tor is not connected.

deskErrOnionUnreachable: The recipient’s wallet is not reachable over Tor. Epicbox delivers a payment while it is offline

@deskErrOnionUnreachable.description: An error message the user reads when a Tor send finds no wallet at the onion address, after a second try; it points to Epicbox, which works while the recipient is offline (the method is not changed).

deskErrWalletBusy: Wallet busy. Try again in a moment.

@deskErrWalletBusy.description: An error message the user reads when the wallet is busy with another operation.

@deskErrDbDamaged.description: An error message the user reads (also a notice on Overview) when the wallet database is damaged and is being rebuilt.

@deskErrPaymentExpired.description: An error message the user reads when a payment has expired.

@deskErrInvoiceNotFound.description: An error message the user reads when an invoice cannot be found.

@deskErrAmountMismatch.description: An error message the user reads when the amount does not match the invoice.

@deskErrInvoicePaid.description: An error message the user reads when an invoice is already paid.

deskErrInvoiceLocked: Invoice locked until a later block

@deskErrInvoiceLocked.description: An error message the user reads when an invoice is locked until a later block.

@deskErrInvoiceChanged.description: An error message the user reads when an invoice changed since it was read.

@deskErrNotAccepted.description: An error message the user reads when the wallet core did not accept an input and gave no detail.

@deskErrNotAcceptedDetail.description: An error message the user reads when the wallet core did not accept an input. {detail} is the core's own English sentence.

@deskErrDisk.description: An error message the user reads when the disk failed, no detail.

@deskErrDiskDetail.description: An error message the user reads when the disk failed. {detail} is the system's English text.

deskErrTorMissing: Tor not included in this build

@deskErrTorMissing.description: Why Tor is down: this build has no Tor program. Shown on the Tor status line.

@deskErrTorNetwork.description: Why Tor is down: the Tor network cannot be reached. Shown on the Tor status line.

@deskErrTorClock.description: Why Tor is down: the computer's clock is wrong. Shown on the Tor status line.

@deskErrOnionNotPublished.description: Why Tor receiving does not work: the onion address is not published. Shown on the Tor status line.

@deskErrTorStart.description: Why Tor is down: the Tor program did not start. Shown on the Tor status line.

@deskErrTorStopped.description: Why Tor is down: Tor stopped. Shown on the Tor status line.

@deskErrScanRunning.description: An error message the user reads when a second balance recheck is asked while one runs.

deskErrCancelRefused: Not cancelled: the node already has this payment.

@deskErrCancelRefused.description: An error message the user reads when a cancel was refused because the node already has the payment.

@deskErrWalletLocked.description: An error message the user reads when an action needs the wallet to be unlocked.

@deskErrWalletLocking.description: An error message the user reads when an action is asked while the wallet is locking.

@deskErrDbDamagedDetail.description: An error message the user reads when the damaged wallet database could not be reopened. {detail} is the second error.

@deskErrWalletClosed.description: An error message the user reads when a change failed and the wallet had to be closed. {detail} is the reason.

@deskErrNotChanged.description: An error message the user reads when a settings change failed. {detail} is the reason.

deskErrPasswordShort: {count, plural, one{Use at least {count} character} other{Use at least {count} characters}}

@deskErrPasswordShort.description: An error message the user reads when a new password is too short. {count} is the minimum length.

@deskErrWalletNotListed.description: An error message the user reads when the wallet is not in the wallet list.

deskErrUpdateApp: Update the app to change the list

@deskErrUpdateApp.description: An error message the user reads when the wallet list was written by a newer app version.

@deskErrListNotChanged.description: An error message the user reads when the wallet list could not be changed, no detail.

deskErrOpenToDelete: Open the wallet to delete it

@deskErrOpenToDelete.description: An error message the user reads when a wallet is deleted without being open.

@deskErrEnterPassword.description: An error message the user reads when a password is needed and empty.

@deskErrFolderNotFound.description: An error message the user reads when a wallet's folder is gone.

@deskErrAlreadyHere.description: An error message the user reads when a recovery phrase belongs to a wallet that is already listed. {name} is the listed wallet's name.

deskErrTestNet: This is a test wallet and cannot be imported.

@deskErrTestNet.description: Shown in the import wizard for an older wallet on the test network.

deskErrWalletInApp: This wallet is in the app already.

@deskErrWalletInApp.description: Shown in the import wizard when every wallet found is already in the app.

@deskErrWalletNotFoundSearch.description: An error message the user reads in the import wizard when the chosen old wallet is gone.

@deskErrEnterOldPassword.description: An error message the user reads in the import wizard when the old password is empty.

deskErrOldPasswordShort: {count, plural, one{The old password is short. Choose a new one of at least {count} character.} other{The old password is short. Choose a new one of at least {count} characters.}}

@deskErrOldPasswordShort.description: An error message the user reads in the import wizard when the old password is shorter than the app's minimum. {count} is the minimum length.

deskErrSeedUnreadable: The wallet.seed file could not be read

@deskErrSeedUnreadable.description: An error message the user reads in the import wizard when wallet.seed cannot be read from disk.

@deskErrNotSeedFile.description: An error message the user reads in the import wizard when the chosen file is not a wallet.seed file.

@deskErrAlreadyInApp.description: An error message the user reads in the import wizard when the wallet is already in the app. {name} is its name.

@deskErrWrongOldPassword.description: An error message the user reads in the import wizard when the old wallet's password is wrong.

@deskErrListNotSaved.description: An error message the user reads in the import wizard when the new wallet could not be listed.

@deskErrProofSeedRead.description: A line of the import wizard's result: the old wallet's seed was read.

@deskErrProofWalletCreated.description: A line of the import wizard's result: the new wallet was created.

deskErrProofContacts: {count, plural, one{1 contact added} other{{count} contacts added}}

@deskErrProofContacts.description: A line of the import wizard's result: contacts taken over from the old app.

deskErrProofContactsMerged: {count, plural, one{1 contact merged with an existing one} other{{count} contacts merged with existing ones}}

@deskErrProofContactsMerged.description: A line of the import wizard's result: old contacts whose address was already in the address book; the missing addresses or note were added to that contact, nothing saved was changed.

deskErrProofContactsKnown: {count, plural, one{1 contact already saved} other{{count} contacts already saved}}

@deskErrProofContactsKnown.description: A line of the import wizard's result: old contacts the address book already had, with nothing to add.

deskErrProofContactsSkipped: {count, plural, one{1 contact skipped: no valid address} other{{count} contacts skipped: no valid address}}

@deskErrProofContactsSkipped.description: A line of the import wizard's result (a warning): old contacts with no Epicbox, HTTP or Tor address the app can send to.

deskErrProofContactAddressesLeftOut: {count, plural, one{1 address not added: it conflicts with a saved contact} other{{count} addresses not added: they conflict with saved contacts}}

@deskErrProofContactAddressesLeftOut.description: A line of the import wizard's result (a warning): valid addresses of old contacts that were not saved, because the matching saved contact already has a different address of that kind, or another contact has the address.

deskErrProofContactsUnreadable: Some old contacts could not be read: the old address book is damaged

@deskErrProofContactsUnreadable.description: A line of the import wizard's result (a warning): the old app's contact database was found but part of it could not be read.

deskErrProofContactsFailed: Not all contacts were saved: the address book could not be written

@deskErrProofContactsFailed.description: A line of the import wizard's result (a warning): saving the imported contacts stopped with an error.

deskErrProofNode: Node {name} added to the node list

@deskErrProofNode.description: A line of the import wizard's result: the old app's node was added to the node list. {name} is the node's label.

@deskErrProofFolderUnchanged.description: A line of the import wizard's result: the old wallet's folder was only read.

deskErrProofFolderChanged: Old folder changed by another program

@deskErrProofFolderChanged.description: A line of the import wizard's result: another program changed the old folder meanwhile.

@deskErrProofHistory.description: A line of the import wizard's result: the old payment history was imported.

@deskErrProofHistoryAlready.description: A line of the import wizard's result.

deskErrProofHistoryNone: No history in the old folder; the scan restores the balance

@deskErrProofHistoryNone.description: A line of the import wizard's result.

deskErrProofHistoryOld: History in an older database format is not readable; the scan restores the balance

@deskErrProofHistoryOld.description: A line of the import wizard's result: the old wallet's history is in an older database format the app cannot read.

deskErrProofHistoryBusy: History not imported: the older wallet is running. It is imported at the next unlock

@deskErrProofHistoryBusy.description: A line of the import wizard's result.

deskErrProofHistoryOther: History not imported: it belongs to another wallet

@deskErrProofHistoryOther.description: A line of the import wizard's result.

deskErrProofHistoryUnreadable: History not imported: the old database could not be read; the scan restores the balance

@deskErrProofHistoryUnreadable.description: A line of the import wizard's result.

@deskErrNodeNoAnswer.description: An error message the user reads when a sync could not reach the node.

@deskErrNotPosted.description: An error message the user reads when a split or consolidation was stored but the node did not take it.

@deskErrNotEpicboxAddress.description: Why a send failed: the address is not an Epicbox address.

deskErrFileNotSaved: File not saved. The payment waits in Activity; cancel it there to free the coins.

@deskErrFileNotSaved.description: Why a file send failed: the transaction file could not be saved.

deskErrTorOffSend: Tor is off. Turn on Tor to send to an onion address.

@deskErrTorOffSend.description: Why a send to an onion address failed: Tor is off.

deskErrTorConnecting: Tor is still connecting. Try again in a moment.

@deskErrTorConnecting.description: Why a send to an onion address failed: Tor is still starting.

deskErrRecipientNoAnswer: The recipient’s wallet did not answer or refused.

@deskErrRecipientNoAnswer.description: Why a direct send failed: nothing was sent.

deskErrRecipientNoAnswerWaits: The recipient’s wallet did not answer or refused. The payment waits in Activity; cancel it there to free the coins.

@deskErrRecipientNoAnswerWaits.description: Why a direct send failed: the payment may exist and waits in Activity.

deskErrNotDelivered: Not delivered. The payment waits in Activity; cancel it there to free the coins.

@deskErrNotDelivered.description: Why an Epicbox send failed: the payment waits in Activity.

deskErrInterruptedLock: Interrupted by the lock. It may have gone out: check Activity after unlocking.

@deskErrInterruptedLock.description: Why a send ended: the wallet was locked during it.

deskErrStoredWaits: {detail}. The payment waits in Activity; cancel it there to free the coins.

@deskErrStoredWaits.description: Why a send failed with a reason, when the payment may exist. {detail} is the reason without its final full stop.

deskErrNodeRefused: Signed by both wallets, but the node refused it. Cancel it in Activity to free the coins.

@deskErrNodeRefused.description: Why a direct send failed: both wallets signed but the node refused the transaction.

@deskErrFileNotReadable.description: An error message the user reads when a transaction file cannot be read from disk.

@deskErrNotTxFile2.description: An error message the user reads when a chosen file is not a transaction file.

@deskErrResponseNotSaved.description: An error message the user reads when the response file could not be written.

@deskErrCannotCancel.description: An error message the user reads when a payment cannot be cancelled.

deskErrNoLocalNode: No local node in this build

@deskErrNoLocalNode.description: An error message the user reads when the local node is asked but this build has none.

@deskErrLocalNodeStopped.description: An error message the user reads when the local node was stopped while starting.

deskErrNotChangedLocked: Not changed: the wallet was locked

@deskErrNotChangedLocked.description: An error message the user reads when the wallet was locked during a change.

@deskErrLocalNodeNotStarted.description: Notice on Overview when the local node did not start. {detail} is the reason.

@deskErrUnknown.description: Reason after "Local node not started:" when nothing more is known. Lowercase.

@deskErrNotServerName.description: An error message the user reads when the Epicbox server name is not valid.

@deskErrPortInUse.description: Why receiving over HTTP did not start: the port is used by another program.

@deskErrPortUnavailable.description: Why receiving over HTTP did not start: the port cannot be opened.

@deskErrStoppedWithError.description: Why receiving over HTTP stopped, no detail.

deskErrPasswordNotChanged: Password not changed. The current password still opens the wallet.

@deskErrPasswordNotChanged.description: An error message the user reads when changing the password failed.

@deskTorLineOff.description: Tor line of the status card and Settings › Receiving when Tor is off. Short.

@deskTorLineReady.description: Tor line of the status card and Settings › Receiving when Tor is ready. Short.

@deskTorLineSendsWork.description: Tor line when the onion address is not published but sending works. {problem} is a short reason such as "Onion address not published".

@deskTorLinePublishing.description: Tor line while the onion address is being published.

@deskTorLineConnecting.description: Tor line while Tor connects. {percent} is a number from 0 to 100.

@deskErrHistOtherWallet.description: Title of the notice when a history backup file was exported from a different wallet.

@deskErrHistOtherChain.description: Title of the notice when a history backup file is from another network.

@deskErrHistNotOurs.description: Title of the notice when a chosen file is not a history backup.

@deskErrHistNewer.description: Title of the notice when a history backup file was made by a newer app version.

@deskErrHistDamaged.description: Title of the notice when a history backup file is incomplete or changed.

@deskErrOldGui.description: Group heading in the import wizard's Find step: wallets made by the older Epic Wallet app.

@deskErrOldCli.description: Group heading in the import wizard's Find step: wallets made by the epic command-line program.

@deskErrOldPicked.description: Group heading in the import wizard's Find step: folders the user picked by hand.

deskErrHistTooLarge: The file is too large to be one.

@deskErrHistTooLarge.description: Why a history backup was refused: the file is far larger than any backup.

deskErrHistChains: The file is from another network.

@deskErrHistChains.description: Why a history backup was refused: it is from another network.

deskErrHistOtherWalletText: The file was exported from a wallet with a different recovery phrase.

@deskErrHistOtherWalletText.description: Why a history backup was refused: it belongs to another wallet.

deskErrHistNewerText: A newer version of the app made this file. Update the app, then import it.

@deskErrHistNewerText.description: Why a history backup was refused: it was made by a newer app version.

deskErrHistDamagedText: The file is incomplete or was changed.

@deskErrHistDamagedText.description: Why a history backup was refused: the file is damaged.

deskErrHistNotOursText: The file was not made by Epic Cash Desktop or Epic Cash Mobile.

@deskErrHistNotOursText.description: Why a history backup was refused: it is not a backup file of this app.

@deskDataHttpEnter.description: Hint under the Send address field when it is empty and the Link method is chosen.

@deskDataHttpScheme.description: Hint under the Send address field: an http address needs its scheme.

@deskDataHttpOnion.description: Hint under the Send address field: an .onion address was typed where an http(s) address is expected.

@deskDataHttpNot.description: Hint under the Send address field: the text is not an http or https address.

@deskDataHttpPort.description: Hint under the Send address field: the port number is out of range.

deskDataUpdTimeout: The update server did not answer.

@deskDataUpdTimeout.description: Update check failed: the server did not answer in time.

deskDataUpdUnreachable: The update server could not be reached.

@deskDataUpdUnreachable.description: Update check failed: the server could not be reached.

@deskDataUpdStatus.description: Update check failed: the server answered with an HTTP error code.

deskDataUpdNone: No desktop update information is published yet.

@deskDataUpdNone.description: Update check: the update list has no entry for the desktop app yet.

deskErrSecretProtect: Windows could not protect the wallet’s secrets (DPAPI refused), so nothing was saved. Sign in to Windows with your own account and its password, not through a remote or service session, then try again.

@deskErrSecretProtect.description: Error when Windows (DPAPI) refused to protect the wallet's secrets, e.g. in a remote or service session. DPAPI and Windows are names.

deskErrOldLinks: This wallet’s folder has links in it, so it is not imported. Restore it from the recovery phrase.

@deskErrOldLinks.description: Import of an old wallet: why it cannot be imported. Its folder contains links (symlinks, junctions); the user restores it from the recovery phrase instead.

deskErrOldIncomplete: This wallet’s folder could not be read completely, so it is not imported. Restore it from the recovery phrase.

@deskErrOldIncomplete.description: Import of an old wallet: why it cannot be imported. Its folder is too big to check or a part could not be read; the user restores it from the recovery phrase instead.

deskErrOldSeedTooLarge: The wallet.seed file is too large to be a wallet seed.

@deskErrOldSeedTooLarge.description: Import of an old wallet: why it cannot be imported. wallet.seed is a file name and stays as written.

deskErrSendUnbuildable: This send cannot be built from the coins available.

@deskErrSendUnbuildable.description: Error when a send or split cannot be made from the wallet's spendable outputs (the core refused it). Nothing was sent.

deskErrNothingToConsolidate: Nothing to consolidate: fewer than two spendable outputs.

@deskErrNothingToConsolidate.description: Error when Consolidate is asked with fewer than two spendable outputs. Nothing was changed.

@deskErrTxNotFound.description: Error when the wallet cannot find the transaction it was asked to send again.

deskErrNotDeliveredRelay: Not delivered: {relay} did not answer. The payment waits in Activity; cancel it there to free the coins.

@deskErrNotDeliveredRelay.description: Why an Epicbox send failed: the recipient's relay did not answer; the payment waits in Activity. {relay} is its host name, as in the address.

@deskErrRelayNoAnswer.description: An error message the user reads when Send again to an Epicbox address fails because the recipient's relay did not answer. {relay} is its host name, as in the address.

deskErrInputsSpentElsewhere: The node shows these coins already spent, and this wallet did not spend them. Most likely another wallet using your recovery phrase did.

@deskErrInputsSpentElsewhere.description: Error when posting a send fails because the chain shows its coins already spent by another wallet using the same recovery phrase. The send is released and a refresh follows.

deskErrMacKeychain: macOS did not let the app read its saved data in the keychain. Quit Epic Cash Desktop and open it again; when macOS asks, enter your Mac login password and choose Always Allow.

@deskErrMacKeychain.description: Error when macOS refused the app access to its keychain items (wrong or locked login keychain, access denied, or a new unsigned build not yet allowed). macOS, Epic Cash Desktop and the button name 'Always Allow' (as macOS shows it in each language) are names.
